groups.title: Match the Sentence Parts - Killing Time is not a Murder!!!

options.text: more important and valuable than money
don't really know how to manage time

sentences.start: People can never get back the time
sentences.full_sentence: People can never get back the time what they had spent
sentences.translation: لا يمكن للناس أبداً استعادة الوقت الذي أنفقوه

sentences.full_sentence: Successful people consider time more important and valuable than money
sentences.translation: يعتبر الأشخاص الناجحون الوقت أكثر أهمية وقيمة من المال

sentences.start: People who say they don't have enough time
sentences.full_sentence: People who say they don't have enough time don't really know how to manage time
sentences.translation: الأشخاص الذين يقولون أنهم لا يملكون وقتاً كافياً لا يعرفون حقاً كيفية إدارة الوقت

sentences.start: Most of our students attain high grades
sentences.full_sentence: Most of our students attain high grades in the final exam
sentences.translation: معظم طلابنا يحصلون على درجات عالية في الامتحان النهائي

sentences.start: She knows how to use her time
sentences.full_sentence: She knows how to use her time efficiently
sentences.translation: هي تعرف كيف تستخدم وقتها بكفاءة

sentences.full_sentence: Hani lost a golden chance because he had not learnt the value of time
sentences.translation: خسر هاني فرصة ذهبية لأنه لم يتعلم قيمة الوقت

sentences.full_sentence: The palace gates had been shut
Once time is spent it will never come back again
sentences.translation: بمجرد أن يضيع الوقت، لن يعود أبداً

sentences.start: The king told him to go into the treasury
sentences.full_sentence: The king told him to go into the treasury and collect as much wealth as you can
sentences.translation: أخبره الملك أن يذهب إلى الخزانة ويجمع ما يستطيع من ثروة

sentences.start: Hani was so happy and rushed home
sentences.full_sentence: Hani was so happy and rushed home to tell his wife
sentences.translation: كان هاني سعيداً جداً وأسرع إلى المنزل ليخبر زوجته
